text: A concert does not always need a stage. Two women sit close to a long wooden string instrument. Follow its body, its strings, and the hands resting above them. The picture is silent, yet the hands suggest music. A newcomer might notice the low instrument and the seated position. Without hearing a note, a visitor could still study how music was made. Clothes alone cannot establish the players social position. Instead, look at the distance between the two figures and the room around them. This work is attributed to Uncho. From the TJ Kim Collection, imagine a small musical moment inside an ordinary room.
